text: Why does your dog sleep with its butt facing you?
You might think it's rude, especially if your dog is gassy.
But vets say it may be the opposite.
Turning its back to you may signal trust.
In packs, dogs may sleep back-to-back so someone's always watching.
A UK study found over eighty-six percent of dogs near people at night chose to be close.
asr: A UK study found over 86% of dogs near people at night chose to be close.

text: So that butt may be saying: I feel safe with you.
Send this to someone whose dog gives them the butt every night.
